caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, shield-shaped design composed of geometric and floral motifs, as well as a simple landscape scene. The topmost band features a horizontal strip of green geometric shapes on a pink background. Below this is a large central section with vibrant, stylized flowers and green leaves, incorporating purple, yellow, pink, and white colors, along with two small blue animal-like figures on each side. There is a horizontal border separating the central floral section from the bottom, done in a green and light blue shade. The bottom section contains a landscape with three boxy buildings—one tall purple structure with a small rooftop, a smaller yellow house, and a green-roofed, gray building—arranged among stylized green trees and grass. The sky above the buildings is pink, and the ground is depicted with shades of green and blue. The entire drawing is framed by a blank, off-white background, with a line of gray loops along the bottom edge of the shield-shaped composition.
title: Purse
